en.headline: Security chief expects Huanggang port to exceed 100,000 daily crossings over Chung Yeung
en.dek: Daily traffic has averaged over 80,000 since the new port opened, with Friday topping 92,000; waiting times remain under 15 minutes.
body: Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung said the new Huanggang Port is expected to handle more than 100,000 passenger crossings on peak days during the three-day Chung Yeung Festival long weekend.

Speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, Tang said daily traffic in recent working days had averaged more than 80,000 people, rising above 92,000 on Friday, compared with 30,000 to 40,000 at the old Huanggang checkpoint. Overall operations have been smooth.

Waiting times are generally under five minutes and less than 15 minutes even at the busiest periods, with many travellers walking straight through or facing only one or two people ahead. Because travellers complete both exit and entry formalities in a single queue, efficiency is at least four times higher than before, Tang said.

Vehicle traffic has averaged about 9,000 trips a day, similar to previous levels, as only certain licence types can use the new port. Crossings at Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau Spur Line have fallen 3 to 7 per cent, or about 10,000 to 20,000 people, which Tang attributed to a shift to Huanggang. Authorities have prepared extra manpower for the holiday peak.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強料重陽長假新皇崗口岸高峰日過關人次破10萬
zh.dek: 新口岸近日日均逾8萬人次，周五超過9.2萬，等候時間一般少於5分鐘，效率較舊口岸提升至少四倍。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，新皇崗口岸在重陽節三天長周末的高峰日，單日過關人次料會突破10萬。
鄧炳強周六在電台節目中說，過去幾個工作日日均旅客超過8萬人次，周五更錄得逾9.2萬，較舊皇崗口岸的每日3至4萬大幅增加。整體運作暢順。
旅客等候時間一般少於5分鐘，最繁忙時亦少於15分鐘，很多時是直行直過或只排一兩人。由於只需排一次隊即可完成出入境，效率至少提升四倍。
車輛方面日均約9,000多架次，與以往相若。羅湖及落馬洲支綫過境人次下降3%至7%，相信有旅客轉用新皇崗。當局已預留人手應付假期高峰。
